Will of the Bone-Line
Will's evacuation plan is a document of unusual moral clarity disguised as logistics.
When Sans deflects and Papyrus declares, the household turns to Will, who asks the only question that has ever de-escalated a Bone-Line argument: what do we actually need tonight?
His inventory reads like a siege plan conducted by a cook — blankets, medicine, lantern oil, and emergency noodles organized by urgency, season, and how many people are likely to show up hungry.
The Missing Wing
Family records describe a brilliant scientist studying darkness itself — not as absence, but as architecture: the load-bearing spaces between worlds where doors could be built, or found.
The Gaster Branch remains unresolved in the registry not because the family has stopped looking, but because every lead so far points at a door no one has agreed to open.
